name: developer/issue-investigation
title: Issue Investigation
description: Investigate a GitHub issue or a locally described bug and produce evidence-backed findings. Read-only: never modifies source. Maps issue language to code areas, inspects the implicated source and history, and records a durable investigation handoff.

symptom.description: The reported symptom, error text, or issue title to investigate

search_term.description: Explicit code search term; defaults to the symptom text

include.description: Restrict the code search to files matching this glob (e.g. *.js)

repo.description: GitHub owner/repository for optional issue enrichment

project.description: Canonical Sidekick project name for the handoff

steps.name: code_search
steps.title: Map the symptom to code areas

steps.name: symptom_search
steps.title: Search for the reported symptom text

steps.name: working_tree
steps.title: Confirm the working tree state at investigation time

args.title: Issue investigation: ${inputs.symptom}
